messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up — Billing shows quota/charges attributed to project=infra-team while token introspect reports project=partner-zen. Suspect header vs claim precedence.
rahul: Confirmed in traces. Auth-proxy still injects X-Project for older integrations and Console currently prefers the header when present.
mike: That explains the misattribution. Proposal: canonicalize to validated token claim `project` when present; fallback to X-Project header only if claim missing.
zoe: Telemetry first: add metric `project_attrib_source{source:introspect|header|none}` and counter `project_attrib_mismatch_total` when header != claim.
rahul: Also sample mismatch traces (cap 1/sec/org) so we can audit integrators deliberately relying on header behavior. Daily top-20 mismatch digest for PMs/Billing.
mike: Compatibility: expose org-level toggle "Allow legacy header attribution". Default ON for existing orgs, OFF for new orgs. Deprecation timeline: 90 days notice before changing existing org defaults.
zoe: Rollout plan: implement in auth-exchange (stamp X-Effective-Project), add feature-flag, add dashboards, canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with 48h observation windows.
mike: Alerts: abort if `project_attrib_mismatch_total` rate >5x baseline OR any single project sees quota burn delta >20%/hour during canary. Add billing watch and runbook.
rahul: I'll open INF-10011 to track PRs, dashboards, comms, and migration doc.
auth-bot: Created INF-10011: "Prefer token claims for project attribution; add telemetry and org compatibility toggle" assigned to rahul, mike
billing-oncall: We will monitor billing; ping 24h before canary and attach the runbook.
zoe: Thanks — moving infra/PR links into INF-10011 to keep this thread high level.
